title: The Skill-Building Method Nobody Talks About
description:
John has built a lot of AI agent skills. He doesn't write a single one himself.

John Groetzinger, the Cisco engineer behind CodeGuard, sits down with Simon to walk through his actual process: dry runs, evals, and why bringing your team in too early is a mistake more people make than admit.

- Why John does a dry run before touching a skill, and lets the model write it instead
- How CodeGuard hit 1.79x improvement over baseline on Tessl's task evals
- When to run evals and when it's just burning budget
- Why the best skills start with one person, not five

Your agents are only as good as the skills you give them. The question is whether you're building those skills the right way.
